references.text: Also mentions the counting of the sons of Israel and that each man shall give a ransom for his soul during the census.
Mentions a shekel per head, 'per skull' (לְגֻלְגֹּלֶת), the same expression as in Num 1:2.
The second census in the book of Numbers, with a similar command to count the entire congregation of Israel.
The execution of the command given in verse 2, where the people were registered by their clans and ancestral houses.
Command to count the sons of Levi by their ancestral houses and clans, all males.
List of the sons of Israel who came to Egypt, organized by ancestral houses and clans.
David ordered a census in Israel, which also involved counting the people.
David commanded Joab to count the people in Israel and Judah.
